newsitem.title: USA: Duff & Phelps rates Shurgard Storage.
newsitem.headline: Duff & Phelps rates Shurgard Storage.

text.p: Duff & Phelps Credit Rating Co said Tuesday it assigned a Triple-B-Minus rating to an expected offering of $50 million Series B cumulative redeemable preferred stock by Shurgard Storage Centers Inc with a rating outlook of stable.
Duff & Phelps said it also assigned a Triple-B rating to an expected concurrent offer of $100 million senior unsecured notes.
Proceeds are expected to be used to reduce bank debt and provide long-term financing for acquisitions and development, Duff & Phelps said.
Shurgard is a real estate investment trust that owns, manages and develops self-storage rental properties.
Its shares closed up 1/8 Tuesday at 26-3/4.
